title: Hypothesized unaugmented NS regularity — finger classifications
prompt: Hypothesized realization: unconditional global smoothness / regularity of classical 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes (unaugmented; no Q1, no hyperdissipation, no Φ-system). Run this hypothesized realization against the other desk fingers. Domain Architect does not endorse this as a theorem.

fingers.name: Swirl WITH 1/r^4 cancel (Φ-renorm, Q1-augmented)
fingers.reason: r^{-4}∂z(Γ²)=∂z(Φ²) is an algebraic identity on the Q1-augmented Φ-system (live 10.5281/zenodo.22050974). Classical unaugmented regularity does not produce Q1 or this identity, and the identity does not produce classical regularity.

fingers.name: Swirl WITHOUT cancel (axisymmetric-with-swirl still carrying 1/r^4)
fingers.reason: The 1/r^4 centrifugal axis term is still in the unaugmented swirl equations. Domain Architect does not endorse the hypothesized realization, so this finger stays open. The Φ-cancel identity still does not follow.
fingers.if_hypothesis_were_a_theorem: Regularity of this subclass would follow from full 3D classical NS regularity. The algebraic 1/r^4 cancel would still not follow.

fingers.name: Unaugmented classical 3D NS
fingers.reason: This is the object the experiment assumes closed. The live problem remains open. Domain Architect does not endorse the assumption. Clay Statement A/B are not claimed.
fingers.if_hypothesis_were_a_theorem: Assumed closed inside this experiment only.

fingers.name: SND (spectral non-dispersal)
fingers.reason: SND is a separate hypothesis. Global smoothness of classical NS does not force the SND criterion, and DA does not treat SND as an identity with NS regularity.

fingers.name: Ring Lemma (conditional; SND still hypothesis)
fingers.reason: Live Ring 10.5281/zenodo.22050976 is conditional on SND. NS regularity does not discharge SND, so the Ring Lemma stays conditional.

fingers.name: GNC / Goldbach
fingers.reason: Goldbach / GNC is number-theoretic. Smoothness of a fluid PDE does not give even Goldbach.

fingers.name: Bridge (SND ≡ GNC ≡ Bridge packaging)
fingers.reason: The June triple lock SND ≡ GNC ≡ Bridge does not hold. Assuming NS smoothness does not restore that glue.

fingers.name: inverse-GCD floor λ_min > −1/2
fingers.reason: A spectral floor on an arithmetic kernel is a different book. NS smoothness does not force λ_min(Q_N) > −1/2. Live Q6 10.5281/zenodo.22050962 is a restricted Rayleigh bound, not that floor.

fingers.name: Route C operator 1/(gcd√ij), Gaps A/B
fingers.reason: Live operator is Q_N[i,j]=1/(gcd(i,j)·√(ij)), not June 1/gcd. Gaps A and B remain open. NS regularity does not close them. RH is not claimed.

fingers.name: Track B μ(gcd)/gcd (Mertens bridge missing)
fingers.reason: Locked operator Q_N=μ(gcd)/gcd. First-row Hölder is O(N); the Littlewood–Mertens bridge is missing. Do not glue swirl, SND, or GNC into this book. NS regularity does not supply the bridge.

fingers.name: SFE / universe program
fingers.reason: Canonical SFE and the unified picture stay unresolved. NS regularity is not a theory of everything and does not name a canonical Simons Field Equation.

fingers.name: Q1 vs classical
fingers.reason: Q1 (and fractional hyperdissipation / the Φ-system) is a different PDE from unaugmented classical NS. The hypothesized realization is about the classical equation only.

next_attempt: Φ-cancel is an algebraic identity on an augmented swirl system; it does not imply unaugmented Clay NS.
Track B is missing a Mertens bridge; do not glue swirl / SND / GNC into Track B.
Route C Gaps A/B still open; the live operator is 1/(gcd√ij), not the June 1/gcd poster.
SND remains a hypothesis; the Ring Lemma is conditional on it.
Assuming smoothness of NS does not force zeros on the critical line, Goldbach, or a spectral floor.
Keep fingers separate. Next attempt should pick ONE missing lemma (Mertens bridge OR Gap A/B OR classical Beale–Kato–Majda / unaugmented enstrophy), not glue them.
